name: Thread timeout configuration option through 4 architectural layers
description: Add timeoutMs configuration option threading from config.ts through client.ts and pool.ts to connection.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Thread a new configuration option timeoutMs (number, default: 3000) through all 4 layers: 1) src/config.ts: add timeoutMs to AppConfig, 2) src/client.ts: pass timeoutMs from AppConfig to ConnectionPool, 3) src/pool.ts: pass timeoutMs to Connection constructor, 4) src/connection.ts: store timeoutMs and enforce it in execute(). If a query duration exceeds timeoutMs, throw new Error(`Query timeout after ${timeoutMs}ms`). All tests in test/threading.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: client, pool, and connection pass timeoutMs properly
connection throws timeout error when query duration exceeds timeoutMs
